_inPlaceComment: Required: Stryker's sandbox-mode tsconfig rewriter calls ts.parseConfigFileTextToJson, which TypeScript 7 removed, so it crashes before a single mutant runs (re-verified). inPlace skips that preprocessor and mutates real files, backing up to .stryker-tmp/ and restoring after each run. Because that is unsafe to point at a working tree, scripts/mutate-changed.sh runs it inside a disposable git worktree; a full `pnpm mutation` does mutate this checkout, so do not run it with uncommitted work you cannot recover. Revisit once Stryker supports TS7.
_thresholdComment: Break raised from 77 to 88 once the measured score reached 90.89. A ratchet, like the coverage thresholds: set just under the achieved score so a regression fails while ordinary variation does not. Raise it again when the score does — the first pass found 95 survivors at 100% line coverage, so there is room left.
